title: scantor script manifest (scantor-script.yaml)
description: The manifest at the root of every script folder. Strict: unknown keys are rejected. Bind it in editors with the modeline `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lonetis/scantor/v<version>/schemas/script-manifest.schema.json`. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express (a language with script support, entry path rules, the expected name) are enforced when a script run builds; see docs/scripts.md.

scantor.description: Manifest format version. Always 1 for this schema.

name.description: Script name: a slug unique per owner among scripts, equal to the script folder name and immutable once the script exists. Not a uuid and not a reserved word.

language.description: Script language: a key of schemas/languages.json whose row has a `script` object. It selects the base image (SCANTOR_BASE) and the default entry.

description.description: One-paragraph human description shown in the UI, CLI and MCP.

entry.description: The source file that defines the script, relative to the image working directory (/task) and present in the script folder. Defaults to the `script.entry` of the language in languages.json (main.py).

defaults.description: Default run settings. Every value can be overridden per run (settings of POST /api/scripts/{script}/runs) and is capped by the instance limits SCANTOR_SCRIPT_RUN_TIMEOUT, SCANTOR_SCRIPT_RUN_MAX_CPUS and SCANTOR_SCRIPT_RUN_MAX_MEMORY.

timeoutMs.description: Total duration of a script run in milliseconds (≥ 1000), counted from its start. Fallback and upper bound: SCANTOR_SCRIPT_RUN_TIMEOUT of the instance.

resources.description: Resources of the script-run container. It gets memoryMiB + 256 MiB of memory.

cpus.description: CPUs of the script-run container (0.1 … 64). Fallback 1. Upper bound: SCANTOR_SCRIPT_RUN_MAX_CPUS of the instance.

memoryMiB.description: Memory of the script in MiB (256 … 65536). Fallback 1024. Upper bound: SCANTOR_SCRIPT_RUN_MAX_MEMORY of the instance.

examples.name: title-report
examples.description: Count the pages with a title and write a CSV report.
